posts.title: KnowAll Is Now Live on Amazon
posts.excerpt:
After months of writing, editing, and countless revisions, KnowAll: The AI That Answered Everything is now available on Amazon Kindle.

Our first original novel explores artificial intelligence, ambition, and the consequences of having access to unlimited knowledge.
posts.body:
Today marks an important milestone for AltWorld Comics.

KnowAll: The AI That Answered Everything is now available on Amazon Kindle.

Unlike our public domain restoration projects, KnowAll is a completely original story created from the ground up.

The novel follows sixteen-year-old Jonathan Reed as he discovers KnowAll, an experimental artificial intelligence capable of answering almost any question. What begins as an opportunity quickly becomes a journey into ambition, responsibility, and the limits of human judgment.

At its core, KnowAll is not a story about technology.

It is a story about choices.

Artificial intelligence can provide answers. But who is responsible for the consequences?

That question became the foundation of the novel and ultimately shaped its conclusion.

We would like to thank everyone who has supported AltWorld Comics throughout our journey.

KnowAll is now available on Amazon Kindle.

Some answers change everything.

posts.title: Dark Tales #1 : Little Red Riding Hood Is Now Available
posts.excerpt: A classic tale rewritten. Dark Tales #1: Little Red Riding Hood is now available on Kindle, introducing the world of the Taletellers and a new vision of fairy tales where every story carries a lesson.
posts.body:
Dark Tales #1: Little Red Riding Hood is now available on Amazon Kindle.

This first issue introduces readers to the world of Dark Tales, an ongoing AltWorld Comics series where classic stories are revisited, expanded, and reimagined.

At the heart of every tale stand the Taletellers — mysterious beings who shape stories, guide their destinies, and influence the lessons they leave behind. Some stories bring hope. Others bring consequence.

Little Red Riding Hood believed her nightmare had ended long ago. But some legends refuse to stay buried.

This digital edition includes:

• A complete original Dark Tales story
• The first appearance of the Taletellers
• Character profile pages
• Bonus comic content
• Exclusive AltWorld Comics material

Dark Tales is the beginning of a larger world where fairy tales, myths, and legends are woven together into a shared universe.

Every tale carries a lesson.

Available now on Kindle.

posts.title: Fantomah Issue #1 Is Now Available
posts.excerpt: The legend continues. Fantomah Issue #1 is now available on Amazon Kindle, featuring two newly reimagined jungle horror adventures alongside their restored classic counterparts.
posts.body:
Fantomah Issue #1 is now live on Amazon Kindle.

This new installment continues our mission of bringing forgotten public domain legends to modern audiences.

Inside this issue:

• Cursed Treasure in the Jungle! – Reimagined Edition
• Mad Science and the Beast-Men! – Reimagined Edition
• Restored classic versions of both original pulp stories
• Publication history and bonus material

As with every AltWorld Comics Classics release, readers can experience both the modern adaptation and the original source material side by side.

Beauty. Terror. Vengeance.

She is Fantomah.

Available now on Amazon Kindle.

posts.title: Fantomah Returns.
posts.excerpt: The first AltWorld Comics release is now live. Fantomah returns in a dark modern reimagining inspired by Golden Age jungle horror.
posts.body:
Fantomah — Issue #0 is officially the first released comic under the AltWorld Comics label.

This special introductory issue reimagines one of the strangest forgotten jungle heroines of the Golden Age through a darker and more cinematic modern lens.

Ancient ruins.
Cursed rituals.
Jungle horror.
Lost civilizations.

Issue #0 acts as the beginning of a larger world while establishing the visual identity and tone of future AltWorld Comics releases.

This is not a simple restoration.

It is a rebirth.

Fantomah returns for a new generation.

posts.title: What Is AltWorld Comics?
posts.excerpt: AltWorld Comics is a dark pulp and retro fantasy comic label focused on forgotten legends, twisted tales and modern mythmaking.
posts.body:
AltWorld Comics was created to bring forgotten worlds back to life.

We focus on dark pulp adventures, retro horror, weird fantasy and reimagined legends inspired by the Golden Age of comics and vintage fantasy storytelling.

Some of our stories rebuild forgotten public domain characters for a modern audience. Others are completely original tales born from the same dark vintage spirit.

Our goal is not simple nostalgia.

We want to preserve the atmosphere, mystery and imagination of classic pulp fiction while combining it with modern cinematic visuals and darker storytelling.

From jungle goddesses and ancient ruins to twisted fairy tales and supernatural horror, AltWorld Comics explores worlds where old myths live again.

Old Tales.
New Adventures.
Different Worlds.

store.title: KnowAll: The AI That Answered Everything
store.description:
Sixteen-year-old Jonathan Reed is tired of being ordinary.

Then he discovers KnowAll, an experimental artificial intelligence capable of answering almost any question.

As success turns into obsession, Jonathan finds himself facing a question no machine can answer:

Who is responsible when knowledge becomes dangerous?

A technological thriller about artificial intelligence, ambition, and responsibility.

about.heading: About AltWorld Comics
about.body:
AltWorld Comics is an independent comic publisher founded by comic fan and storyteller Tutku Tuzlu.

For many years, creating comics remained out of reach. Like countless aspiring creators, Tutku had stories, characters, and worlds he wanted to share, but lacked the artistic training, industry connections, and financial resources traditionally required to produce comic books.

Modern AI-assisted creative tools changed that.

Not by creating the stories, but by making them possible to share.

The ideas behind AltWorld Comics existed long before the technology. The characters, worlds, and stories came first. AI simply became one of the tools that allowed those ideas to take visual form.

AltWorld Comics publishes original stories, modern reimaginings of forgotten public domain characters, and experimental creator-driven projects.

The goal is not to compete with major publishers.

The goal is to tell stories.

Our Approach to AI

AltWorld Comics believes talented artists create things that AI simply cannot.

A skilled artist brings experience, artistic vision, and years of dedication to their craft. Nothing published by AltWorld Comics is intended to diminish that work.

Instead, AI is viewed as a creative tool that lowers barriers for people who have stories to tell but lack the resources required to produce traditional comics.

Without modern AI-assisted tools, AltWorld Comics would likely never have existed.

Why AltWorld Comics Exists

Because stories deserve a chance to be told.

What began as a lifelong passion for comics became an opportunity to preserve forgotten characters, create original worlds, and share stories that otherwise might have remained only ideas.

AltWorld Comics is not a large studio.

It is not backed by investors.

It is simply an independent publisher built around imagination, storytelling, and a love of comics.

— AltWorld Comics
